I'll be making the final call on the water-control plan, but I want to hear from quality, maintenance, and EHS first. Let's start the huddle -- what updates do each of you have for me?

decisions.reclaimed_water_plan: Use reclaimed water for Line Y's scheduled batch only. Line X will not use reclaimed water due to conductivity exceeding its process limit. Before use, perform a 3-hour membrane flush on the recovery skid, adjust residual sanitizer to 0.3 ppm, and record a signed sanitizer log for each use day. Conductivity test must be recorded before Line Y's batch begins.

commitments.detail: Ravi must upload the conductivity test result (1,800 microsiemens/cm) to the shared quality folder before Line Y's batch begins.
Mei must enter the recovery skid inspection findings (3-hour flush requirement, 600 L/hr max delivery) into the work-order system.
Jon must attach the permit review findings to the site's permit record and ensure a signed sanitizer log is completed for each use day.
Line X will not receive reclaimed water. Line X must use municipal process water or adjust its schedule to comply with the 48-hour conservation restriction.
Line Y's batch of 1,800 liters will use reclaimed water at 600 L/hr, requiring 3 hours of delivery after the 3-hour membrane flush is completed.
